adventure.name: The Beginner's Cave
adventure.description: A simple cavern for new adventurers to test their mettle. Many have entered. Some have returned.
adventure.style_prompt_prefix: Eyvind Earle Sleeping Beauty 1959 style, geometric angular Gothic architecture, jewel-tone palette of deep purples and midnight blues with burnished gold accents, Byzantine and Persian miniature influence, architectural depth with layered planes, painterly backgrounds with light-defined detail, flat graphic characters with subtle shading, Celtic ornamental details
adventure.author: Donald Brown

locations.name: Cave Entrance
locations.narration_text: You stand at the mouth of a damp cave. The walls glisten with moisture. Flickering torches cast dancing shadows on rough stone. A narrow tunnel leads north into darkness.
locations.background_description: Rocky cave entrance, moss-covered stone walls, flickering torchlight casting warm orange glow, damp ground with puddles, angular Gothic rock formations, dark tunnel mouth leading north

locations.name: Damp Corridor
locations.narration_text: The corridor stretches east and west. Water drips steadily from the ceiling, creating a rhythmic tapping echo.
locations.background_description: Narrow stone corridor, water dripping from ceiling, wet stone floor with reflections, distant torchlight glow, angular stone arches, damp atmosphere

locations.name: Goblin Den
locations.narration_text: A foul stench fills this chamber. Bones litter the floor. In the shadows, something moves. A goblin shrieks and attacks!
locations.background_description: Cave chamber with bones scattered on floor, dark corners with shadows, rough stone walls, ominous red glow from unseen source, debris and filth, threatening atmosphere

locations.name: Underground River
locations.narration_text: An underground river rushes past, its waters black as obsidian. The sound is deafening. A rickety bridge crosses to the east bank.
locations.background_description: Underground cavern with rushing river, black water with reflections, rickety wooden bridge, stalactites hanging from ceiling, blue-green bioluminescent glow from water, dramatic perspective

locations.name: Hidden Cache
locations.narration_text: Behind a false wall, you discover a small chamber. Dusty chests and forgotten sacks sit undisturbed. Someone's treasure, left unguarded.
locations.background_description: Small secret chamber behind stone wall, dusty wooden chests, cloth sacks, cobwebs, single shaft of light from above, treasure scattered on stone floor, mysterious atmosphere

locations.name: Chamber of Rest
locations.narration_text: A surprisingly clean chamber with a stone bench. Old campfire ashes suggest other adventurers have rested here. You feel safe.
locations.background_description: Small clean cave chamber, stone bench carved from wall, cold campfire ashes in center, warm torchlight, welcoming atmosphere, evidence of past visitors

locations.name: The Mimic's Lair
locations.narration_text: A tempting chest sits in the corner. As you approach, it sprouts legs and teeth! The mimic lunges!
locations.background_description: Dark cave chamber, treasure chest in corner that is actually a monster with teeth and legs, surprise attack moment, dramatic lighting, monster partially transformed

locations.name: Pirate's Cove
locations.narration_text: A hidden cove where pirates once stored their loot. The remains of a camp suggest recent occupation. A skull leers from atop a crate.
locations.background_description: Hidden underground cove, pirate camp remains, wooden crates and barrels, skull decoration, tattered pirate flag, scattered gold coins, torchlit with dramatic shadows

characters.name: Cynthia
characters.description: A fellow adventurer resting by the fire. She wears leather armor and carries a short sword.
characters.portrait_description: Young female adventurer, leather armor, kind face with warm smile, short brown hair, holding sword, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style with subtle shading, Celtic ornamental trim on armor
characters.first_encounter_text: Oh! Another brave soul. I'm Cynthia. Careful in the east tunnel — I heard growling.

characters.name: Cave Goblin
characters.description: A wiry green goblin with jagged teeth and rusty dagger.
characters.portrait_description: Green goblin, wiry build, jagged yellow teeth, rusty dagger in hand, aggressive snarl, ragged clothing, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style with angular features
characters.first_encounter_text: The goblin shrieks and lunges at you with its dagger!

characters.name: Mimic
characters.description: A predatory creature disguised as a treasure chest. Rows of teeth and grasping pseudopods.
characters.portrait_description: Mimic monster as treasure chest with teeth and tongue, wooden texture turning into flesh, grasping tentacle-legs, surprise attack pose, Eyvind Earle stylized horror
characters.first_encounter_text: The chest sprouts legs and teeth! The mimic attacks!
characters.special_ability: Surprise attack: first round attacks with advantage

characters.name: Skeleton Pirate
characters.description: An undead pirate, bones held together by dark magic. Wields a rusted cutlass.
characters.portrait_description: Skeleton pirate, bones held by dark magic, rusted cutlass, tattered pirate hat, glowing eye sockets, menacing pose, Eyvind Earle stylized undead
characters.first_encounter_text: The skeleton pirate rattles its bones and raises its cutlass!

characters.name: Old Hermit
characters.description: An elderly hermit who dwells in the deeper caves. He may help or hinder.
characters.portrait_description: Elderly hermit, long white beard, tattered robes, wise but wary eyes, holding wooden staff, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style, Celtic ornamental details on staff
characters.first_encounter_text: The herit squints at you. 'Not many come this deep, traveler. What do you seek?'

items.name: Healing Potion
items.description: A small vial of glowing red liquid. Smells of herbs and honey.

items.name: Rusty Dagger
items.description: A crude iron dagger, pitted with rust but still sharp.

items.name: Rusted Cutlass
items.description: A sailor's blade, corroded by salt and time.

items.name: Troll's Fire
items.description: A flaming blade that burns with cold fire. Rare and valuable.

items.name: Bag of Diamonds
items.description: A small leather bag containing uncut diamonds.

items.name: Velvet Jewels
items.description: A velvet pouch of assorted precious gems.
